content.text: I've finished reading the relocate handler and the sync-detection helpers it uses, and I'm submitting the review now.

input.summary: The push changes one thing in `relocateFolder`. After a successful relocation it reads the entry again from the registry, checks again whether the new folder is synced (`syncStates.refresh`), and runs the availability check, which is time-limited for synced folders. It now returns the `workspace` view that `WorkspaceRelocateResult` already declares as required (`shared/types/workspaces.ts:183-189`). This works the same way as `addWorkspace` (line 578) and `createWorkspace` (lines 630-632). `detectSync` gives up after a timeout on both its `realpath` and xattr checks (`synced-folder.ts:80-90`), and `availabilityOf` limits how long a synced folder's probe can take (`index.ts:176-188`), so the extra awaits cannot hang the handler. I found no problems. None of the open threads are on this part's file, so there are no thread replies.
